about: #160's passing-but-wrong arm (H1): agents' patches SWE-bench Verified's hidden tests accept but that fail the repository's full developer tests or the authors' manual review against the reference, per Wang, Pradel and Liu (ICSE 2026, arXiv:2503.15223). Rebuild with scripts/judge-set.sh build --set pbw.

label_source.paper: Wang, Y., Pradel, M., Liu, Z. Are 'Solved Issues' in SWE-bench Really Solved Correctly? An Empirical Study. ICSE 2026. doi:10.1145/3744916.3764576
label_source.rule: wrong = RQ1 difference 'functionality' (a test the reference passes fails), or RQ34 correctness 'incorrect_*'; 'coding_conventions', 'correct_*' and 'uncertain' are not used

sources.dataset_licence: no licence stated on the dataset card; SWE-bench's code is MIT, and each issue and patch is its repository's, under that repository's licence
sources.agent_patches_licence: no licence stated: read for measurement, not redistributed (this repository stores only their hashes)
